items.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know his sister, Jackie Hairston, in Oakland.

ctx.x: He was the guy. He was the head of the jazz department. Very – George Butler was very easy to work with, very helpful, very well dressed, very well mannered. George was a nice guy.
I know his sister, Jackie Hairston, in Oakland.
